categories.main_business_segments: AIG operates through three main business segments: North America Commercial, International Commercial, and Global Personal. North America Commercial covers insurance businesses in the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda; International Commercial includes operations in Japan, the UK, Europe, EMEA, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and China; and Global Personal focuses on personal insurance products worldwide. Other Operations primarily consist of investment income from the parent liquidity portfolio, Corebridge dividend income, corporate expenses, and interest expense.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AIG's core operations rely on advanced underwriting frameworks, actuarial modeling, and risk management systems to price and manage insurance products. The company leverages data analytics, digital platforms, and increasingly, artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance underwriting, claims processing, and workflow automation. Investment management is largely outsourced to BlackRock, utilizing sophisticated asset allocation and risk management strategies tailored to insurance liabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AIG serves a broad spectrum of customers, including individuals, small and medium-sized businesses, and large multinational corporations, including many Fortune 500 companies. Its key markets span commercial property and casualty, specialty lines, personal auto and homeowners, accident and health, and high-net-worth individual insurance. Distribution is achieved through brokers, agents, affinity partners, and direct channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIG operates in over 200 countries and jurisdictions, with significant business in North America, Europe, the UK, Japan, Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East/Africa. Approximately 47% of employees are in North America, 26% in Asia Pacific, and 27% in EMEA and Latin America, reflecting its global reach and diversified geographic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: AIG operates as a downstream provider in the insurance value chain, directly underwriting and servicing insurance policies for end customers. It also acts as a risk aggregator and manager, utilizing reinsurance and capital markets to manage its own risk exposures. The company does not manufacture physical goods but provides financial risk transfer and management solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AIG's strategic priorities include delivering sustainable underwriting profitability, optimizing its streamlined operating structure post-Corebridge deconsolidation, investing in talent and workplace learning, and expanding data and digital strategies, particularly in AI and data quality. The company emphasizes innovation in underwriting, claims, and operational excellence, while maintaining financial flexibility and capital strength.
categories.revenue_model: AIG generates revenue primarily through insurance premiums earned on commercial and personal insurance products, as well as investment income from its managed asset portfolios. Additional revenue streams include fees, commissions, and, to a lesser extent, gains from divestitures and investment activities. Profitability depends on underwriting discipline, risk management, and effective investment strategies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIG competes with global, national, and local insurers and reinsurers, including major property and casualty insurance organizations and specialty underwriters. The company is positioned as a leading global insurer with a strong capital base, broad product offerings, and multinational capabilities, differentiating itself through underwriting expertise and global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, AIG reported total assets of $161 billion and shareholders’ equity of $43 billion. Net premiums written were $23.9 billion in 2024, with adjusted pre-tax income of $4.3 billion. The company has demonstrated strong underwriting profitability and investment income growth, though overall net income was impacted by the deconsolidation of Corebridge and related discontinued operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIG emphasizes world-class underwriting and claims expertise, global reach, and a diversified product portfolio as its key differentiators. The company highlights its ability to serve complex, multinational clients, provide tailored risk solutions, and leverage data-driven insights and digital innovation to deliver superior customer service and operational excellence.
